references.text: David expresses a deep sorrow in his soul, which reflects Jesus' feelings in Mark 14:34.
David again speaks of his soul being troubled, parallel to Jesus' deep sorrow.
Repetition of David's feeling of deep sorrow, similar to what Jesus expressed.
The prophecy of the Messiah as a man of sorrows, connected with Jesus' sorrow in Gethsemane.
Matthew's parallel account of Jesus' sorrow in Gethsemane.
Luke's description of Jesus' intense prayer and sorrow in Gethsemane.
